[LDIA.9.3] **`realtime`** has `default`'s settings with `realtime: true`
and `constspace: true`. It leaves `linear_scan: true`: a hard real-time
program may join by scan, because under `constspace` every scan is bounded
by a stated capacity ([LCAP.2.1]). A program that also wants each join
constant in the number of facts writes `linear_scan: false` in its `use`
block.
